<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionfind.lockexclusive" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionFind::lockExclusive</refname>
  <refpurpose>Execute operation with EXCLUSIVE LOCK</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::lockExclusive</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>int</type><parameter>lock_waiting_option</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Locks the document exclusively.
   As long as the document is locked,
   other transactions can't update the document,
   use <code>SELECT ... LOCK IN SHARE MODE</code>,
   or read the data in certain transaction isolation levels.
   Consistent reads ignore any locks set on the records that exist in the read view.
  </para>
  <para>
   To avoid concurrency problems, it makes sense to use this function with the
   <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Collection::modify</methodname> method. Essentially, this function uses row locks to serialise
   access to rows.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>lock_waiting_option</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Optional waiting option. By default it is <constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_DEFAULT</constant>. Valid values are these constants:
     </para>
     <itemizedlist>
      <listitem><para><constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_DEFAULT</constant></para></listitem>
      <listitem><para><constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_NOWAIT</constant></para></listitem>
      <listitem><para><constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_SKIP_LOCKED</constant></para></listitem>
     </itemizedlist>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   Returns a CollectionFind object that can be used for further processing.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::lockExclusive</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$session->startTransaction();

$result = $collection
  ->find("age > 50")
  ->lockExclusive()
  ->execute();

// ... do an operation on the object

// Complete the transaction and unlock the document
$session->commit();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionfind.lockshared" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionFind::lockShared</refname>
  <refpurpose>Execute operation with SHARED LOCK</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::lockShared</methodname>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>int</type><parameter>lock_waiting_option</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Allows to share the documents between multiple transactions which are locking in shared mode.
  </para>
  <para>
   Other sessions can read the rows, but cannot modify them until your transaction commits. 
  </para>
  <para>
   If any of these rows were changed by another transaction that hasn't been committed,
   the query will wait until that transaction has ended to be able to use the latest values.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>lock_waiting_option</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Optional waiting option. By default it is <constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_DEFAULT</constant>. Valid values are these constants:
     </para>
     <itemizedlist>
      <listitem><para><constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_DEFAULT</constant></para></listitem>
      <listitem><para><constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_NOWAIT</constant></para></listitem>
      <listitem><para><constant>MYSQLX_LOCK_SKIP_LOCKED</constant></para></listitem>
     </itemizedlist>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionFind object that can be used for further processing
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::lockShared</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$session->startTransaction();

$result = $collection
  ->find("age > 50")
  ->lockShared()
  ->execute();

// ... read the object in shared mode

// Complete the transaction and unlock the document
$session->commit();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionfind.offset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionFind::offset</refname>
  <refpurpose>Skip given number of elements to be returned</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::offset</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>int</type><parameter>position</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Skip (offset) these number of elements that otherwise would be returned
   by the find operation. Use with the limit() method.
  </para>
  <para>
   Defining an offset larger than the result set size results in an empty set.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>position</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Number of elements to skip for the limit() operation.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionFind object that can be used for additional processing.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::offset</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$create = $schema->createCollection("people");
$create
  ->add('{"name": "Alfred", "age": 18, "job": "Butler"}')
  ->execute();
$create
  ->add('{"name": "Reginald", "age": 42, "job": "Butler"}')
  ->execute();

// ...

$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

$result = $collection
  ->find()
  ->sort('age asc')
  ->offset(1)
  ->limit(1)
  ->execute();

var_dump($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(1) {
  [0]=>
  array(4) {
    ["_id"]=>
    string(28) "00005b6b536100000000000000f3"
    ["age"]=>
    int(42)
    ["job"]=>
    string(6) "Butler"
    ["name"]=>
    string(8) "Reginald"
  }
}
]]>

 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionfind.sort" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionFind::sort</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the sorting criteria</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::sort</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Sort the result set by the field selected in the sort_expr argument. The allowed
   orders are ASC (Ascending) or DESC (Descending). This operation is equivalent to the 'ORDER BY' SQL operation
   and it follows the same set of rules.
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      One or more sorting expressions can be provided. The evaluation is from left to right,
      and each expression is separated by a comma.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionFind object that can be used to execute the command, or to add additional operations.
  </para>
 </refsect1>


 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionFind::sort</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$create = $schema->createCollection("people");
$create
  ->add('{"name": "Alfred", "age": 18, "job": "Butler"}')
  ->execute();
$create
  ->add('{"name": "Reginald", "age": 42, "job": "Butler"}')
  ->execute();

// ...

$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

$result = $collection
  ->find()
  ->sort('job desc', 'age asc')
  ->execute();

var_dump($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(2) {
  [0]=>
  array(4) {
    ["_id"]=>
    string(28) "00005b6b53610000000000000106"
    ["age"]=>
    int(18)
    ["job"]=>
    string(6) "Butler"
    ["name"]=>
    string(6) "Alfred"
  }
  [1]=>
  array(4) {
    ["_id"]=>
    string(28) "00005b6b53610000000000000107"
    ["age"]=>
    int(42)
    ["job"]=>
    string(6) "Butler"
    ["name"]=>
    string(8) "Reginald"
  }
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.arrayappend" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::arrayAppend</refname>
  <refpurpose>Append element to an array field</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::arrayAppend</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>collection_field</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>expression_or_literal</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Add an element to a document's field, as multiple elements of a field are represented as an array.
   Unlike arrayInsert(), arrayAppend() always appends the new element
   at the end of the array, whereas arrayInsert() can define the location.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>collection_field</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      The identifier of the field where the new element is inserted.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>expression_or_literal</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      The new element to insert at the end of the document field array.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionModify object that can be used to execute the command, or to add additional operations.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::arrayAppend</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$result = $collection
  ->add(
  '{"name":   "Bernie",
    "traits": ["Friend", "Brother", "Human"]}') 
  ->execute();

$collection
  ->modify("name in ('Bernie', 'Jane')")
  ->arrayAppend('traits', 'Happy')
  ->execute();

$result = $collection
  ->find()
  ->execute();

print_r($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => Array
        (
            [_id] => 00005b6b5361000000000000010c
            [name] => Bernie
            [traits] => Array
                (
                    [0] => Friend
                    [1] => Brother
                    [2] => Human
                    [3] => Happy
                )
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.arrayinsert" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::arrayInsert</refname>
  <refpurpose>Insert element into an array field</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::arrayInsert</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>collection_field</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>expression_or_literal</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Adds an element to a document's field, as multiple elements of a field are
   represented as an array. Unlike
   <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::arrayAppend</methodname> this
   method allows to specify where the new element is inserted by defining
   which item it is after, whereas
   <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::arrayAppend</methodname> always
   appends the new element at the end of the array.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>collection_field</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Identifies the item in the array after which the new element will be inserted.
      The format of this parameter is
      <literal><replaceable>FIELD_NAME[ INDEX ]</replaceable></literal> where
      <replaceable>FIELD_NAME</replaceable> is the name of the document field
      to add the element to, and <replaceable>INDEX</replaceable>
      is the INDEX of the element within the field.
     </para>
     <para>
      The INDEX field is zero based, so the first item of the array has an index of 0.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>expression_or_literal</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      The new element to insert after FIELD_NAME[ INDEX ]
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionModify object that can be used to execute the command, or to add additional operations
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::arrayInsert</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$result = $collection
  ->add(
  '{"name":   "Bernie",
    "traits": ["Friend", "Brother", "Human"]}') 
  ->execute();

$collection
  ->modify("name in ('Bernie', 'Jane')")
  ->arrayInsert('traits[1]', 'Happy')
  ->execute();

$result = $collection
  ->find()
  ->execute();

print_r($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => Array
        (
            [_id] => 00005b6b5361000000000000010d
            [name] => Bernie
            [traits] => Array
                (
                    [0] => Friend
                    [1] => Happy
                    [2] => Brother
                    [3] => Human
                )
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.bind" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::bind</refname>
  <refpurpose>Bind value to query placeholder</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::bind</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>placeholder_values</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Bind a parameter to the placeholder in the search condition of the modify operation.
  </para>
  <para>
   The placeholder has the form of :NAME where ':' is a common prefix that must always exists before any NAME
   where NAME is the name of the placeholder. The bind method accepts a list of placeholders if multiple
   entities have to be substituted in the search condition of the modify operation.
  </para>

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>placeholder_values</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Placeholder values to substitute in the search condition. Multiple values are allowed
      and have to be passed as an array of mappings PLACEHOLDER_NAME->PLACEHOLDER_VALUE.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionModify object that can be used to execute the command, or to add additional operations.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::bind</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$result = $collection
  ->add(
  '{"name":   "Bernie",
    "traits": ["Friend", "Brother", "Human"]}') 
  ->execute();

$collection
  ->modify("name = :name")
  ->bind(['name' => 'Bernie'])
  ->arrayAppend('traits', 'Happy')
  ->execute();

$result = $collection
  ->find()
  ->execute();

print_r($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => Array
        (
            [_id] => 00005b6b53610000000000000110
            [name] => Bernie
            [traits] => Array
                (
                    [0] => Friend
                    [1] => Brother
                    [2] => Human
                    [3] => Happy
                )
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.limit" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::limit</refname>
  <refpurpose>Limit number of modified documents</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::limit</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>int</type><parameter>rows</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Limit the number of documents modified by this operation.
   Optionally combine with skip() to define an offset value.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>rows</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      The maximum number of documents to modify.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionModify object.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::limit</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$collection->add('{"name": "Fred",  "age": 21, "job": "Construction"}')->execute();
$collection->add('{"name": "Wilma", "age": 23, "job": "Teacher"}')->execute();
$collection->add('{"name": "Betty", "age": 24, "job": "Teacher"}')->execute();

$collection
  ->modify("job = :job")
  ->bind(['job' => 'Teacher'])
  ->set('job', 'Principal')
  ->limit(1)
  ->execute();

$result = $collection
  ->find()
  ->execute();

print_r($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => Array
        (
            [_id] => 00005b6b53610000000000000118
            [age] => 21
            [job] => Construction
            [name] => Fred
        )
    [1] => Array
        (
            [_id] => 00005b6b53610000000000000119
            [age] => 23
            [job] => Principal
            [name] => Wilma
        )
    [2] => Array
        (
            [_id] => 00005b6b5361000000000000011a
            [age] => 24
            [job] => Teacher
            [name] => Betty
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.replace" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">

 </refsect1>

    <listitem>

<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();

  ->add(

  ->find()
  ->execute();

print_r($result->fetchAll());
?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.skip" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::skip</refname>
  <refpurpose>Skip elements</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::skip</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>int</type><parameter>position</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Skips the first N elements that would otherwise be returned by a find operation.
   If the number of elements skipped is larger than the size of the result set,
   then the find operation returns an empty set.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>position</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Number of elements to skip.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionModify object to use for further processing.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::skip</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$coll->modify('age > :age')->sort('age desc')->unset(['age'])->bind(['age' => 20])->limit(4)->skip(1)->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

Source text below is untrusted reference content. Acquisition does not verify technical claims.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.sort" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::sort</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the sorting criteria</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::sort</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Sorts the result set by the field selected in the sort_expr argument. The allowed
   orders are ASC (Ascending) or DESC (Descending). This operation is equivalent to the 'ORDER BY' SQL operation
   and it follows the same set of rules.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      One or more sort expressions can be provided. The evaluation is from
      left to right and each expression must be separated by a comma.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   CollectionModify object that can be used for further processing.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::sort</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$res = $coll->modify('true')->sort('name desc', 'age asc')->limit(4)->set('Married', 'NO')->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionmodify.unset" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionModify::unset</refname>
  <refpurpose>Unset the value of document fields</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::unset</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>fields</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Removes attributes from documents in a collection.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>fields</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      The attributes to remove from documents in a collection.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   CollectionModify object that can be used for further processing.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionModify::unset</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$res = $coll->modify('job like :job_name')->unset(["age", "name"])->bind(['job_name' => 'Plumber'])->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionremove.bind" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionRemove::bind</refname>
  <refpurpose>Bind value to placeholder</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove::bind</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>placeholder_values</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Bind a parameter to the placeholder in the search condition of the remove operation.
  </para>
  <para>
   The placeholder has the form of :NAME where ':' is a common prefix that must always exists before any NAME
   where NAME is the name of the placeholder. The bind method accepts a list of placeholders if multiple
   entities have to be substituted in the search condition of the remove operation.
  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>placeholder_values</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Placeholder values to substitute in the search condition. Multiple values are allowed
      and have to be passed as an array of mappings PLACEHOLDER_NAME->PLACEHOLDER_VALUE.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionRemove object that can be used to execute the command, or to add additional operations.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove::bind</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$res = $coll->remove('age > :age_from and age < :age_to')->bind(['age_from' => 20, 'age_to' => 50])->limit(7)->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionremove.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionRemove::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>CollectionRemove constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <para>
   Removes collection documents and is instantiated by the
   <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Collection::remove</methodname> method.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\Collection::remove</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("people");

$collection->add('{"name": "Alfred", "age": 18, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();
$collection->add('{"name": "Bob",    "age": 19, "job": "Painter"}')->execute();

// Remove all painters
$collection
  ->remove("job in ('Painter')")
  ->execute();

// Remove the oldest butler
$collection
  ->remove("job in ('Butler')")
  ->sort('age desc')
  ->limit(1)
  ->execute();

// Remove record with lowest age
$collection
  ->remove('true')
  ->sort('age desc')
  ->limit(1)
  ->execute();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-collectionremove.sort" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CollectionRemove::sort</refname>
  <refpurpose>Set the sorting criteria</refpurpose>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove::sort</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Sort the result set by the field selected in the sort_expr argument. The allowed
   orders are ASC (Ascending) or DESC (Descending). This operation is equivalent to the 'ORDER BY' SQL operation
   and it follows the same set of rules.
  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      One or more sorting expressions can be provided. The evaluation is from left to right,
      and each expression is separated by a comma.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CollectionRemove object that can be used to execute the command, or to add additional operations.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CollectionRemove::sort</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$res = $coll->remove('true')->sort('age desc')->limit(2)->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-columnresult.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>ColumnResult::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>ColumnResult constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\ColumnResult::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <para>
   Retrieves column metadata, such as its character set; this is instantiated
   by the <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getColumns</methodname> method.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\ColumnResult::__construct</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS nonsense")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE nonsense")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE nonsense.numbers (hello int, world float unsigned)")->execute();
$session->sql("INSERT INTO  nonsense.numbers values (42, 42)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("nonsense");
$table  = $schema->getTable("numbers");

$result1 = $table->select('hello','world')->execute();

// Returns an array of ColumnResult objects
$columns = $result1->getColumns(); 

foreach ($columns as $column) {
    echo "\nColumn label " , $column->getColumnLabel();
    echo " is type "       , $column->getType();
    echo " and is ", ($column->isNumberSigned() === 0) ? "unsigned." : "signed.";
}

// Alternatively
$result2 = $session->sql("SELECT * FROM nonsense.numbers")->execute();

// Returns an array of FieldMetadata objects
print_r($result2->getColumns()); 
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[

Column label hello is type 19 and is signed.
Column label world is type 4  and is unsigned.

Array
(
    [0] => mysql_xdevapi\FieldMetadata Object
        (
            [type] => 1
            [type_name] => SINT
            [name] => hello
            [original_name] => hello
            [table] => numbers
            [original_table] => numbers
            [schema] => nonsense
            [catalog] => def
            [collation] => 0
            [fractional_digits] => 0
            [length] => 11
            [flags] => 0
            [content_type] => 0
        )
    [1] => mysql_xdevapi\FieldMetadata Object
        (
            [type] => 6
            [type_name] => FLOAT
            [name] => world
            [original_name] => world
            [table] => numbers
            [original_table] => numbers
            [schema] => nonsense
            [catalog] => def
            [collation] => 0
            [fractional_digits] => 31
            [length] => 12
            [flags] => 1
            [content_type] => 0
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-crudoperationbindable.bind" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CrudOperationBindable::bind</refname>
  <refpurpose>Bind value to placeholder</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>abstract</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationBindable</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationBindable::bind</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>array</type><parameter>placeholder_values</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Binds a value to a specific placeholder.
  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>placeholder_values</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      The name of the placeholders and the values to bind.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CrudOperationBindable object.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationBindable::bind</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$res = $coll->modify('name like :name')->arrayInsert('job[0]', 'Calciatore')->bind(['name' => 'ENTITY'])->execute();
$res = $table->delete()->orderby('age desc')->where('age < 20 and age > 12 and name != :name')->bind(['name' => 'Tierney'])->limit(2)->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


</refentry>

   <methodparam><type>int</type><parameter>rows</parameter></methodparam>

  <variablelist>

    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>

  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationLimitable::limit</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[

$res = $coll->find()->fields(['name as n','age as a','job as j'])->groupBy('j')->limit(11)->execute();

?>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-crudoperationsortable.sort" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>CrudOperationSortable::sort</refname>
  <refpurpose>Sort results</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>abstract</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationSortable</type>
   <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationSortable::sort</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Sort the result set by the field selected in the sort_expr argument. The allowed
   orders are ASC (Ascending) or DESC (Descending). This operation is equivalent to the 'ORDER BY' SQL operation
   and it follows the same set of rules.
  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>sort_expr</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      One or more sorting expressions can be provided. The evaluation is from left to right,
      and each expression is separated by a comma.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A CrudOperationSortable object.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\CrudOperationSortable::sort</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php

$res = $coll->find('job like \'Cavia\'')->sort('age desc', '_id desc')->execute();

?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
  </example>
 </refsect1>


</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-docresult.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>DocResult::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>DocResult constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\DocResult::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <para>
   Fetch document results and warnings, 
   and is instantiated by CollectionFind.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title>A DocResult example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$create = $schema->createCollection("people");

$create->add('{"name": "Alfred", "age": 18, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();
$create->add('{"name": "Reginald", "age": 42, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();

// ...

$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

// Yields a DocResult object
$result = $collection
  ->find('job like :job and age > :age')
  ->bind(['job' => 'Butler', 'age' => 16])
  ->sort('age desc')
  ->limit(1)
  ->execute();

var_dump($result->fetchAll());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(1) {
  [0]=>
  array(4) {
    ["_id"]=>
    string(28) "00005b6b536100000000000000f3"
    ["age"]=>
    int(42)
    ["job"]=>
    string(6) "Butler"
    ["name"]=>
    string(8) "Reginald"
  }
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-docresult.getwarnings" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>DocResult::getWarnings</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get warnings from last operation</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>Array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\DocResult::getWarnings</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Fetches warnings generated by MySQL server's last operation.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   An array of Warning objects from the last operation. Each object
   defines an error 'message', error 'level', and error 'code'. An empty
   array is returned if no errors are present.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\DocResult::getWarnings</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$create = $schema->createCollection("people");

$create->add('{"name": "Alfred", "age": 18, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();
$create->add('{"name": "Reginald", "age": 42, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();

// ...

$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

// Yields a DocResult object
$result = $collection
  ->find('job like :job and age > :age')
  ->bind(['job' => 'Butler', 'age' => 16])
  ->sort('age desc')
  ->execute();

if (!$result->getWarningsCount()) {
    echo "There was an error:\n";
    print_r($result->getWarnings());
    exit;
}

var_dump($result->fetchOne());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[

There was an error:

Array
(
    [0] => mysql_xdevapi\Warning Object
        (
            [message] => Something bad and so on
            [level] => 2
            [code] => 1365
        )
    [1] => mysql_xdevapi\Warning Object
        (
            [message] => Something bad and so on
            [level] => 2
            [code] => 1365
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-docresult.getwarningscount" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>DocResult::getWarningsCount</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get warning count from last operation</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>int</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\DocResult::getWarningsCount</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Returns the number of warnings raised by the last operation. Specifically, 
   these warnings are raised by the MySQL server.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   The number of warnings from the last operation.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\DocResult::getWarningsCount</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$create = $schema->createCollection("people");

$create->add('{"name": "Alfred", "age": 18, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();
$create->add('{"name": "Reginald", "age": 42, "job": "Butler"}')->execute();

// ...

$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

// Yields a DocResult object
$result = $collection
  ->find('job like :job and age > :age')
  ->bind(['job' => 'Butler', 'age' => 16])
  ->sort('age desc')
  ->execute();

if (!$result->getWarningsCount()) {
    echo "There was an error:\n";
    print_r($result->getWarnings());
    exit;
}

var_dump($result->fetchOne());
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(4) {
  ["_id"]=>
  string(28) "00005b6b53610000000000000135"
  ["age"]=>
  int(42)
  ["job"]=>
  string(6) "Butler"
  ["name"]=>
  string(8) "Reginald"
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-executable.execute" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Executable::execute</refname>
  <refpurpose>Execute statement</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>abstract</modifier> <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\Result</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Executable::execute</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Execute the statement from either a collection operation or a table query;
   this functionality allows for method chaining.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   One of the Result objects, such as Result or SqlStatementResult.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title>execute() examples</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$result_sql = $session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

var_dump($result_sql);


$schema     = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collection = $schema->createCollection("humans");

$result_collection = $collection->add(
  '{"name": "Jane",
    "jobs": [{"title":"Scientist","Salary":18000}, {"title":"Mother","Salary":0}],
    "hobbies": ["Walking","Making pies"]}');

$result_collection_executed = $result_collection->execute();

var_dump($result_collection);
var_dump($result_collection_executed);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
object(mysql_xdevapi\SqlStatementResult)#3 (0) {
}

object(mysql_xdevapi\CollectionAdd)#5 (0) {
}

object(mysql_xdevapi\Result)#7 (0) {
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-result.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Result::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Result constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Result::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <para>
   An object that retrieves generated IDs, AUTO_INCREMENT values, and warnings,
   for a Result set.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\Result::__construct</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("
  CREATE TABLE addressbook.names
    (id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(30), age INT, PRIMARY KEY (id))
  ")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$table  = $schema->getTable("names");

$result = $table->insert("name", "age")->values(["Suzanne", 31],["Julie", 43])->execute();
$result = $table->insert("name", "age")->values(["Suki", 34])->execute();

$ai = $result->getAutoIncrementValue();
var_dump($ai);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
int(3)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

  <refname>Result::getGeneratedIds</refname>

 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Result::getGeneratedIds</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Fetch the generated _id values from the last operation. 
   The unique _id field is generated by the MySQL server.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   An array of generated _id's from the last operation, 
   or an empty array if there are none.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\Result::getGeneratedIds</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$create = $schema->createCollection("people");

$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

$result = $collection->add(
  '{"name": "Bernie",
    "jobs": [{"title":"Cat Herder","Salary":42000}, {"title":"Father","Salary":0}],
    "hobbies": ["Sports","Making cupcakes"]}',
  '{"name": "Jane",
    "jobs": [{"title":"Scientist","Salary":18000}, {"title":"Mother","Salary":0}],
    "hobbies": ["Walking","Making pies"]}')->execute();

$ids = $result->getGeneratedIds();
var_dump($ids);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(2) {
  [0]=>
  string(28) "00005b6b53610000000000000064"
  [1]=>
  string(28) "00005b6b53610000000000000065"
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-result.getwarnings" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Result::getWarnings</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get warnings from last operation</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Result::getWarnings</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Retrieve warnings from the last Result operation.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   An array of Warning objects from the last operation. Each object
   defines an error 'message', error 'level', and error 'code'. An
   empty array is returned if no errors are present.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getWarnings</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE foo")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE foo.test_table(x int)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("foo");
$table  = $schema->getTable("test_table");

$table->insert(['x'])->values([1])->values([2])->execute();

$res = $table->select(['x/0 as bad_x'])->execute();
$warnings = $res->getWarnings();

print_r($warnings);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => mysql_xdevapi\Warning Object
        (
            [message] => Division by 0
            [level] => 2
            [code] => 1365
        )
    [1] => mysql_xdevapi\Warning Object
        (
            [message] => Division by 0
            [level] => 2
            [code] => 1365
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-rowresult.fetchall" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>RowResult::fetchAll</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get all rows from result</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::fetchAll</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Fetch all the rows from the result set.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A numerical array with all results from the query; each result is
   an associative array. An empty array is returned if no
   rows are present.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

<refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::fetchAll</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE addressbook.names(name text, age int)")->execute();
$session->sql("INSERT INTO addressbook.names values ('John', 42), ('Sam', 33)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$table  = $schema->getTable("names");

$row = $table->select('name', 'age')->execute()->fetchAll();

print_r($row);
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => Array
        (
            [name] => John
            [age] => 42
        )
    [1] => Array
        (
            [name] => Sam
            [age] => 33
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?php

$session->sql("CREATE TABLE addressbook.names(name text, age int)")->execute();

      <entry>

 <refsect1 role="examples">

<?php

]]>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-rowresult.getcolumnnames" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>RowResult::getColumnNames</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get all column names</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getColumnNames</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Retrieve column names for columns present in the result set.
  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A numerical array of table columns names,
   or an empty array if the result set is empty.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getColumnNames</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE foo")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE foo.test_table(x int)")->execute();
$session->sql("INSERT INTO addressbook.names values ('John', 42), ('Sam', 33)")->execute();

$sql = $session->sql("SELECT * from addressbook.names")->execute();

$colnames = $sql->getColumnNames();
  
print_r($colnames);
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => name
    [1] => age
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-rowresult.getcolumns" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>RowResult::getColumns</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get column metadata</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getColumns</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Retrieve column metadata for columns present in the result set.
  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   An array of FieldMetadata objects representing the columns in the result, 
   or an empty array if the result set is empty.

$session->sql("CREATE TABLE foo.test_table(x int)")->execute();
$session->sql("INSERT INTO addressbook.names values ('John', 42), ('Sam', 33)")->execute();

$sql = $session->sql("SELECT * from addressbook.names")->execute();

$cols = $sql->getColumns();
  
print_r($cols);

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-rowresult.getwarnings" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>RowResult::getWarnings</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get warnings from last operation</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getWarnings</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Retrieve warnings from the last RowResult operation.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   An array of Warning objects from the last operation. Each object
   defines an error 'message', error 'level', and error 'code'. An empty
   array is returned if no errors are present.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getWarnings</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE foo")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE foo.test_table(x int)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("foo");
$table  = $schema->getTable("test_table");

$table->insert(['x'])->values([1])->values([2])->execute();

$res = $table->select(['x/0 as bad_x'])->execute();
$warnings = $res->getWarnings();

print_r($warnings);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [0] => mysql_xdevapi\Warning Object
        (
            [message] => Division by 0
            [level] => 2
            [code] => 1365
        )
    [1] => mysql_xdevapi\Warning Object
        (
            [message] => Division by 0
            [level] => 2
            [code] => 1365
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-rowresult.getwarningscount" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>RowResult::getWarningsCount</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get warning count from last operation</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>int</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getWarningsCount</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
    Retrieve the number of warnings from the last RowResult operation.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   The number of warnings generated by the last operation.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\RowResult::getWarningsCount</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS foo")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE foo")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE foo.test_table(x int)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("foo");
$table  = $schema->getTable("test_table");

$table->insert(['x'])->values([1])->values([2])->execute();

$res = $table->select(['x/0 as bad_x'])->execute();

echo $res->getWarningsCount();
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
2
]]>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.construct" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::__construct</refname>
  <refpurpose>Schema constructor</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <constructorsynopsis>
   <modifier>private</modifier> <methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::__construct</methodname>
   <void />
  </constructorsynopsis>
  <para>
   The Schema object provides full access to the schema (database).
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::__construct</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE food.fruit(name text, rating text)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("food");
$schema->createCollection("trees");

print_r($schema->gettables());
print_r($schema->getcollections());
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [fruit] => mysql_xdevapi\Table Object
        (
            [name] => fruit
        )
)
Array
(
    [trees] => mysql_xdevapi\Collection Object
        (
            [name] => trees
        )
)
]]>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.createcollection" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::createCollection</refname>
  <refpurpose>Add collection to schema</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\Collection</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::createCollection</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
   <methodparam choice="opt"><type>string</type><parameter>validate</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Create a collection within the schema.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Collection name.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>validate</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Validation definition, as a JSON object.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   The Collection object.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="changelog">
    &reftitle.changelog;
    <informaltable xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.createcollection.changelog">
     <tgroup cols="2">
      <thead>
       <row>
        <entry>&Version;</entry>
        <entry>&Description;</entry>
       </row>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
       <row>
        <entry>8.0.20</entry>
        <entry>
         Added the optional validate parameter.
        </entry>
       </row>
      </tbody>
     </tgroup>
    </informaltable>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::createCollection</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE food.fruit(name text, rating text)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("food");
$schema->createCollection("trees");

print_r($schema->gettables());
print_r($schema->getcollections());
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [fruit] => mysql_xdevapi\Table Object
        (
            [name] => fruit
        )
)
Array
(
    [trees] => mysql_xdevapi\Collection Object
        (
            [name] => trees
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
  <example>
    <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::createCollection</methodname> example</title>
    <programlisting role="php">
 <![CDATA[
 <?php
 $collection = $schema->createCollection("mycollection", '{
	"validation": {
		"level": "strict",
		"schema": {
			"id": "http://json-schema.org/geo",
			"description": "A geographical coordinate",
			"type": "object",
			"properties": {
				"latitude": {
					"type": "number"
				},
				"longitude": {
					"type": "number"
				}
			},
			"required": ["latitude", "longitude"]
		}
	}
}');
// Succeeds
$collection->add('{"latitude": 10, "longitude": 20}')->execute();

// Fails, invalid types (not numbers)
$collection->add('{"latitude": "lat", "longitude": "long"}')->execute();
]]>
    </programlisting>
   </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.dropcollection" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::dropCollection</refname>
  <refpurpose>Drop collection from schema</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::dropCollection</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>collection_name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>

  </para>

  &warn.undocumented.func;

 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>collection_name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>

     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>

  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::dropCollection</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE food.fruit(name text, rating text)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("food");

$schema->createCollection("trees");
$schema->dropCollection("trees");
$schema->createCollection("buildings");

print_r($schema->gettables());
print_r($schema->getcollections());
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Array
(
    [fruit] => mysql_xdevapi\Table Object
        (
            [name] => fruit
        )
)
Array
(
    [buildings] => mysql_xdevapi\Collection Object
        (
            [name] => buildings
        )
)
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.existsindatabase" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::existsInDatabase</refname>
  <refpurpose>Check if exists in database</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>bool</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::existsInDatabase</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Checks if the current object (schema, table, collection, or view) exists
   in the schema object.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   &true; if the schema, table, collection, or view still exists in the schema, else &false;.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::existsInDatabase</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE TABLE food.fruit(name text, rating text)")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("food");
$schema->createCollection("trees");

// ...

$trees = $schema->getCollection("trees");

// ...

// Is this collection still in the database (schema)?
if ($trees->existsInDatabase()) {
    echo "Yes, the 'trees' collection is still present.";
}
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
Yes, the 'trees' collection is still present.
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.getcollection" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::getCollection</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get collection from schema</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\Collection</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::getCollection</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Get a collection from the schema.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Collection name to retrieve.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   The Collection object for the selected collection.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::getCollection</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");

$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS food")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE food")->execute();

$schema = $session->getSchema("food");
$schema->createCollection("trees");

// ...

$trees = $schema->getCollection("trees");

var_dump($trees);
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->
<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.getcollectionastable" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::getCollectionAsTable</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get collection as a Table object</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>mysql_xdevapi\Table</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::getCollectionAsTable</methodname>
   <methodparam><type>string</type><parameter>name</parameter></methodparam>   
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Get a collection, but as a Table object instead of a Collection object.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  <variablelist>
   <varlistentry>
    <term><parameter>name</parameter></term>
    <listitem>
     <para>
      Name of the collection to instantiate a Table object from.
     </para>
    </listitem>
   </varlistentry>
  </variablelist>
 </refsect1>
 
 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   A <classname>mysql_xdevapi\Table</classname> object for the collection.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::getCollectionAsTable</methodname> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema  = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collect = $schema->createCollection("people");
$collect->add('{"name": "Fred",  "age": 21, "job": "Construction"}')->execute();
$collect->add('{"name": "Wilma", "age": 23, "job": "Teacher"}')->execute();

$table      = $schema->getCollectionAsTable("people");
$collection = $schema->getCollection("people");

var_dump($table);
var_dump($collection);
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
object(mysql_xdevapi\Table)#4 (1) {
  ["name"]=>
  string(6) "people"
}

object(mysql_xdevapi\Collection)#5 (1) {
  ["name"]=>
  string(6) "people"
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<!-- $Revision$ -->

<refentry xml:id="mysql-xdevapi-schema.getcollections" xmlns="http://docbook.org/ns/docbook" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
 <refnamediv>
  <refname>Schema::getCollections</refname>
  <refpurpose>Get all schema collections</refpurpose>
 </refnamediv>

 <refsect1 role="description">
  &reftitle.description;
  <methodsynopsis>
   <modifier>public</modifier> <type>array</type><methodname>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::getCollections</methodname>
   <void />
  </methodsynopsis>
  <para>
   Fetch a list of collections for this schema.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="parameters">
  &reftitle.parameters;
  &no.function.parameters;
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="returnvalues">
  &reftitle.returnvalues;
  <para>
   Array of all collections in this schema, where each array element
   value is a Collection object with the collection name as the key.
  </para>
 </refsect1>

 <refsect1 role="examples">
  &reftitle.examples;
  <example>
   <title><function>mysql_xdevapi\Schema::getCollections</function> example</title>
   <programlisting role="php">
<![CDATA[
<?php
$session = mysql_xdevapi\getSession("mysqlx://user:password@localhost");
$session->sql("DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS addressbook")->execute();
$session->sql("CREATE DATABASE addressbook")->execute();

$schema  = $session->getSchema("addressbook");
$collect = $schema->createCollection("people");
$collect->add('{"name": "Fred",  "age": 21, "job": "Construction"}')->execute();
$collect->add('{"name": "Wilma", "age": 23, "job": "Teacher"}')->execute();

$collections = $schema->getCollections();
var_dump($collections);
?>
]]>
   </programlisting>
   &example.outputs.similar;
   <screen>
<![CDATA[
array(1) {
  ["people"]=>
  object(mysql_xdevapi\Collection)#4 (1) {
    ["name"]=>
    string(6) "people"
  }
}
]]>
   </screen>
  </example>
 </refsect1>

</refentry>
